name: MEXA
title: MEXA: Multilingual Evaluation of English-Centric LLMs via Cross-Lingual Alignment
description: Estimated MEXA scores: the alignment of each language with English in the model, computed on parallel sentences and scaled by the model's English score on a task. Higher is better. Each entry of 'files' is one original table, with its rows (languages) and columns (models, then avg) in the original order and every value as given.

styles.arc: ARC style: mean pooling over layers, scaled by the English ARC score
styles.belebele: Belebele style: max pooling over layers, scaled by the English Belebele score

files.description: FLORES-200 (first 100 devtest sentences), mean pooling over layers, scaled by the model's English ARC score

column_notes.avg: mean over the models of this file (as in the original table)

column_notes.avg: mean over the models of this file (as in the original table)
